source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
This rule grants two auras:

- Your **ANATHEMA PSYKANA** units have **Null Aegis (Aura)**: models in an **ADEPTUS CUSTODES** unit within 6" of such a unit have Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds and Psychic Attacks.
- Every other **ADEPTUS CUSTODES** unit of yours has **Deadly Unity (Aura)**: models in an **ANATHEMA PSYKANA** unit within 6" of it get +1 to their Hit rolls.

Neither aura says the unit it affects must be friendly.
